eligibility_test: Only a primary L_sys object-language relation with source-typed cognitive-system instances can be adjudicated as direct Grammar-v0 FULL/PARTIAL/RESIDUAL. A second-order assertion about a grammar, comparator, protocol, evidence, or scientific inference is not such a relation even when it references L_sys.
reference_test: For every Stage D relation referencing L_sys, preserve its source relation arguments and check any explicit referent name against the already-frozen Grammar v0 schema roles or G_cog schema object. Mark candidate/new/hypothetical role nouns as mentions rather than established new primitives.

reference_categories.ROLE_PROVENANCE_OR_FACTORING: Reports origin or interpretative refactor of declared schema roles; not an observed cognitive process.
reference_categories.STRICT_COMPARATOR_META_VIEW: Reports a declared projection over schema roles; evidence for that test belongs to method L_claim.
reference_categories.ARCHITECTURE_SCHEMA_REFERENCE: Types the declared schema or layers, not an instance-level system relation.
reference_categories.CROSS_BOUNDARY_TYPE_DISTINCTION: Distinguishes internal K, C or interface P role from world coupling/experimental entities. Distinction is not an instance-level transition.
reference_categories.NEGATED_OR_NON_ENTAILED_ROLE_REFERENCE: Explicit negative or unlicensed role/ontology/boundary inference; hypothetical nouns cannot be counted as realized Grammar roles.

guardrails: Do not manufacture direct L_sys relations from 47 meta-level self-targets to produce a non-vacuous PASS.
K and Gamma remain distinct and experiment scheduling does not become P_in/P_out.
An explicitly mentioned hypothetical new role is not an observed or proposed role gap.
Source claims' old Grammar mapping is already frozen: do not rerun the 60 or 16 source relations as reflexive data.
No claim-level complete AssertionCarrier v2 fit or role gap verdict is produced by referent-only auditing.
Evidence grade is not an input to eligible-role decisions; retrospective support can be joined for discussion only after classifications are frozen.
stage_output: Frozen classification of 68 self-target relations by direct role eligibility, with detailed referent audit of 16 typed L_sys-bearing relations. A zero eligible denominator must be reported as NOT_TESTABLE_DIRECT, never 100 percent success.
stage_f_handoff: Independent label-suppressed reconstruction still required. A typed metaclaim skeleton is not itself an exact logical or scientific reconstruction.
